articles.title: Resetting account credentials
articles.body: After a password reset, wait up to five minutes, clear the existing browser session, and sign in again. Escalate after three failed attempts with the timestamp and error code.

articles.title: Billing correction policy
articles.body: Agents may explain a charge and collect a transaction reference. Refunds over AUD 100 or any disputed identity require billing-team review. Never request a full card number.

articles.title: Service incident response
articles.body: Acknowledge impact, avoid an unverified restoration time, link the approved status update, and route widespread incidents to the incident commander.

articles.title: Data privacy and identity
articles.body: Do not repeat passwords, payment card numbers, government identifiers, or authentication tokens. Mask contact details in internal summaries and escalate suspected exposure.

articles.title: Single sign-on configuration
articles.body: For SSO login issues, verify the identity-provider metadata URL, signing certificate, claimed email domain, and system clock. Record the SAML request ID and timestamp before escalating repeated authentication failures.

articles.title: API rate limits and pagination
articles.body: For HTTP 429 responses, honour the Retry-After header, use bounded exponential backoff, and preserve the request ID. Follow cursor pagination links without increasing the approved page size or retrying non-idempotent requests.

articles.title: Data exports and retention
articles.body: CSV account exports are prepared asynchronously in UTC and the download link expires after 24 hours. Completed export files are retained for 30 days; agents should verify the requested date range and timezone before starting a replacement export.

articles.title: Agent workspace notifications
articles.body: Agents can configure assignment alerts, email notifications, daily digests, and temporary mute windows in workspace preferences. Confirm the affected channel and notification rule before changing a preference.
